name: Lagoon 450
description: Four double cabins and four bathrooms, built in 2014 and refitted since. There's a hammock on deck for the hour after lunch, and a flybridge above the saloon for the first coffee of the day. Paddleboards, a kayak and snorkel gear are always ready, and the watermaker keeps fresh water coming between anchorages.
